summary: Configure one evidence-backed push-pull GPIO output and create an explicit HAL write/toggle module.
requires: A validated board profile whose MCU matches the new project.
One manual-evidenced, available output pin, including its connected load, voltage/current constraints, polarity, and documented safe startup level.
The selected MCU's local CubeMX GPIO mode and pin XML proving the exact GPIO_Output signal; use only a direct pin assignment accepted by the installed CubeMX command interface.
A local generated-output check for the requested initial PinState whenever it is not CubeMX's observed default.
verifications: Verify the generated .ioc assigns the approved GPIO_Output signal and any declared PinState property.
Verify generated main.c writes the documented initial level and initializes the approved port/pin as GPIO_MODE_OUTPUT_PP with the approved pull and speed values.
Compile the project after module integration.
